reuse.why: Follows the tree's existing pre-link guard pattern (ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in the registration wrappers) and adds a sibling guard rather than touching each provider link body.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once; the only repetition is the same one-line call added to each of the six link wrappers, which already repeat the existing guard call.

placement.why: The guard sits next to ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked and runs before any link work, matching where the tree validates link requests.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear rule, but each provider wrapper must now remember two guards; folding both into one pre-link check would stop the next provider from missing one.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers go through ensureAccountIsOpen and the existing duplicate-link guard.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; only repeated call lines.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts ensureAccountIsOpen defines the closed-account rule once and every *-accounts-link wrapper (gocardless, simplefin, pluggyai, akahu, enablebanking, fintegra) calls it, though the call is added separately in each wrapper.
